verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Gusto 'handles multi-state tax requirements', supports 'multi-location management' and 'tax configuration and compliance', with employees required to configure federal and state tax info, and payroll processing across different-state work locations with configurable schedules (gusto-docs-44, gusto-docs-45, gusto-docs-31, gusto-docs-55). This directly matches the story of running payroll across states with correct registrations/withholdings. Missing for 10: no detail on how state registrations are obtained/managed, no independent/hands-on confirmation of multi-state tax accuracy, and no community evidence specifically validating this capability.
